edges.reason: transfer() forwards msg.sender as the sender of the balance update.
transferFrom() uses msg.sender as the spender when decrementing allowance.
unlock() authorization depends solely on msg.sender matching _previousOwner.
lock() derives _lockTime directly from block.timestamp, creating timestamp dependency.
unlock() gate compares block.timestamp against _lockTime.
swapTokensForEth supplies block.timestamp as the swap deadline.
addLiquidity supplies block.timestamp as the liquidity deadline.
_transfer executes swapAndLiquify, which performs external ETH transfers, before the sender balance is debited.
_transfer short-circuits into _basicTransfer whenever inSwapAndLiquify is set.
_transfer calls getfee to compute the net amount credited to the recipient.
swapAndLiquify pays marketing and development ETH through transferToAddressETH before addLiquidity settles state.
transferToAddressETH performs the raw native transfer to an owner-controlled address.
swapAndLiquify converts the swap portion of tokens to ETH via swapTokensForEth.
swapAndLiquify adds the remaining tokens and ETH back as liquidity.
swapAndLiquify divides tAmount by totaltax, which is fragile because totaltax is owner-configurable and can be zero.
swapTokensForEth invokes the external router swap entry point.
addLiquidity invokes the external value-bearing router call.
Public transfer() delegates execution to the internal _transfer routine.
Public transferFrom() delegates execution to the internal _transfer routine.
settax rewrites totaltax from owner-supplied fee values.
settax recomputes cooldown from totaltax and burn.
changeRouterVersion overwrites the uniswapV2Router state variable.
changeRouterVersion overwrites the uniswapV2Pair state variable.
_transfer debits and credits the _balances mapping for both parties.
_transfer reads and relies on the inSwapAndLiquify guard flag to prevent nested swap execution.
getfee credits the collected fee into the contract's own _balances entry.
The constructor creates and assigns the initial uniswapV2Pair.
The constructor assigns the initial uniswapV2Router.
The constructor initializes totaltax from the configured fee components.

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter only exists to feed the ETH push performed by transferToAddressETH.
The amount parameter is consumed directly by the transfer call inside transferToAddressETH.
The contract token balance local is a temporary used only by the _transfer decision branch.
tAmount is the sole input of swapAndLiquify and drives its fee and swap arithmetic.
The sender parameter is only meaningful inside the internal _transfer routine.
The recipient parameter is only meaningful inside the internal _transfer routine.
The amount parameter is only meaningful inside the internal _transfer routine.
